title_patterns_that_work: Direct questions about whether popular apps/services actually pay or work (e.g., KashKick, Rocket Money, Sweatcoin)
Use of parental/insider confirmation phrasing like 'I Checked the Data' or 'I Checked the Numbers'
Short-form content targeting high-intent consumer apps and financial services
title_patterns_to_avoid: Long-form deep dives into niche or low-search topics that resulted in near-zero views
Generic titles lacking a specific brand, app, or high-curiosity hook
notes: Shorts significantly outperform long-form videos in view velocity for this channel. Content focused on money-making apps, financial tools, and consumer scams (KashKick, Rocket Money, Sweatcoin) drives the highest engagement, whereas long-form video essays currently struggle to gain traction.
